heading: Annual assessment of cattle and hog industries
lead: Not later than March 1 of each year, the Secretary shall submit to Congress and make publicly available a report that—

tree.text: assesses the general economic state of the cattle and hog industries;
describes changing business practices in those industries; and
identifies market operations or activities in those industries that appear to raise concerns under this chapter.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 415 of act Aug. 15, 1921, was renumbered section 417 and is classified to section 229c of this title.
